html: טטף (perh. √ of foll.; meaning dub.; DlPr 46 comp. Assyrian ṭaṭâpu, surround, encircle; Thes Di prop. √ טוף (cf. Arabic طَافَ go around), whence טוטפות = טפטפות; Kn., foll. by KleinJPTh 1881, 673 al., assumes √ טפף tap, strike, comp. στίγμα, and thinks of actual sign or mark in the flesh as orig. meant).
